title: Typography / Substitute font Nunito
slide_intent: Provide an intentional fallback because teams need a coherent option when primary fonts are unavailable.
strategic_value: A rounded substitute can reduce arbitrary typographic variation in Duolingo documents.
demonstration: Four Nunito specimen blocks accompany the conditional fallback instruction and a Google Fonts link.
practical_value: Use the approved substitute when access to brand fonts is unavailable.
